class.name: IfcInventory
class.brief_description: An inventory is a list of items within an enterprise. Various types of inventory can be included. These are identified by the range of values within the inventory type enumeration which includes space, asset, and furniture. User defined inventories can also be defined for lists of particular types of element such as may be required in operating and maintenance instructions. Such inventories should

members.member: A list of the types of inventories from which that required may be selected. IFC2x4 CHANGE Attribute made optional. In IFC2X3 files, this is the [code]InventoryType[/code] attribute. A String, one of the enumeration's values, or null when unset.
The organizational unit to which the inventory is applicable.
Persons who are responsible for the inventory. An Array of GDIFCEntityBase entities, or null when unset.

The date on which the last update of the inventory was carried out. IFC2x4 CHANGE Type changed from IfcDateTimeSelect. A String in IFC4 and IFC4X3_ADD2 files, a GDIFCEntityBase in IFC2X3 files, or null when unset.
An estimate of the current cost value of the inventory.
An estimate of the original cost value of the inventory.
